selected_script.angle: Safe and mess-free summer cooling relief for dogs without gel or cords
selected_script.hook: Is your dog panting all summer? I finally found a cooling mat that actually works and has zero messy gel or cords.

script_record.segment_01: Is your dog panting all summer? I finally found a cooling mat that actually works and has zero messy gel or cords.
script_record.segment_02: It uses cool-to-the-touch breathable fabric to release body heat naturally. Plus, the non-slip bottom keeps it perfectly in place on my hardwood floors.
script_record.segment_03: The best part? It's machine washable and totally fur-resistant. Give your furry best friend the ultimate summer upgrade today!
